title: Hit Distance
description: The mod shows the distance between you and the player who hit you. Designed to understand the enemy's attack range in PVP. It only works on the client, so it depends on your ping and ping of your your opponent's ping.
body:
This mod allows you to understand when the enemy has hit you beyond the capabilities of vanilla Minecraft (3 or more blocks in survival).

The mod shows the enemy's attack distance, and if he is more than 3 blocks away, a text with the strike distance will appear on the screen. You can also customize the mod settings.
